integrity: All identities are proved in the accompanying RESULT.md; finite exact checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Earliest verified public date is the online publication date of the motivating article. No independent review or historical-priority certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full fourth-order mixed-Euler recurrence at 0<lambda<1. Symplectic foliation and two-cycle classification occur at exactly lambda=1/2. Elliptic Floquet type is not nonlinear stability; the theorem does not classify all recurrent dynamics or continuous-time circuit behavior.
title: Centered memristive-cell resonance: global symplectic leaves and the complete two-cycle spectrum
